bait_content.title: Profile I/O Lock Detected
bait_content.body: System detected a stale Chrome profile lock after an unclean shutdown. Background processes are blocking cache and certificate store updates. This may cause tab restore and sign-in failures. Run a safe repair to release the lock and reindex the cache (≈30s). Error: EBUSY: SingletonLock.
